reply.escRefund: For a refund request or a dispute, the team has to look at your order: I can't handle it here. Write to us on WhatsApp or through the contact form, with your order number (WX-…).
reply.escHealth: I can't give medical advice. If you feel discomfort, an allergy or an injury, stop using the product and see a health professional. For any complaint, write to the team on WhatsApp or through the contact form.
reply.escLegal: I can't give legal advice. The team can answer you on WhatsApp or through the contact form, and our terms are published on the site.
reply.order: To track an order, use the tracking page with your WX-… number and the phone number or e-mail of the order. I don't look up orders here.
reply.thanks: My pleasure! Feel free to ask if you have other questions.
reply.hello: Hello! Tell me what you're looking for, who it's for or your budget.
